gallery.title: File:Wanganui Panorama from Durie Hill Tower - Cropped for Wikivoyage.jpg
gallery.description: Panoramic view of Wanganui city and the adjacent stretch of the lower reaches of the Wanganui River taken from  the top of the Durie Hill Tower. The wide, placid silty river flows down from the middle right to the left. On both sides of the river suburban areas of Wanganui can be seen, with predominately wooden bungalows with some lowrise buildings in the forground near the river. The riverbanks have rows of green trees and parks. Taken by me on the 1st of may 2014. Automatically generated panorama by android phone. Taken from the top of the Durie Hill Tower in Wanganui, New Zealand. Cropped to better fit as a banner for the Wanganui wikivoyage page.
